title: Relatives
text: “So, is it Keel-kun’s brother? Family?”
“Hell if I know this guy. Never seen a kid like this among my relatives.”
“Well, they’re a Hero, after all. Not Keel-kun’s relative.”
“Then this—this must be a destined encounter, Keel-kun!”
“Huh?”
“What destined encounter!? Don’t tell me you’re gonna start spouting ‘destiny’ too!”
That was Kuro-chan, indeed. Luna-chan, eyes absolutely sparkling, leapt at Ren while still cradling Keel in her arms.
“Whoa!? W-what the—!?”
Ren couldn’t keep up with Luna-chan’s thoroughly buffed speed and ended up scooped right up, indeed. He was squeezed into a tight hug just like that. Keel too, of course, indeed.
“Gyaaaaaah!? I’m getting buried!? The feathers are wrapping around me!? What’s happening!?”
“Let go! Luna-chan! What are you planning, catching me again!? Gyaaaaah!”
“Muhuhuhu… Luna’s cute Keel-kuns have multiplied. Luna’s gonna show everyone and dote on them.”
“S-somebody! Help! Guh! Haah!”
Ren swung his sword in resistance, but couldn’t cut through Luna-chan’s buffed feathers and only got tangled up further, indeed.
“M-Motoyasu! If it’s a Filolial, you’re the owner, aren’t you!? Help me out!”
“No use asking Spear Big Bro for help! In this situation… Big Bro-!”
“L-Luna-chan, calm down!”
Father tried to stop the utterly delighted Luna-chan, but she just kept smiling and showed no sign of stopping, indeed.
“Welt, Bak—”
Ren tried smoothly calling out to his companions for help, but they were looking over at Rafumi and Kuro-chan, and Luna-chan’s feathers seem to have muffled his voice, indeed.
“Uuuuu…”
Ren’s paw-padded hand clawed sadly at empty air.
“R-Rafumi!”
The moment he called that name in irritation, it wasn’t the Rafumi acting as Ren’s body double but a different Rafumi who appeared nearby and answered, indeed.

“Hoh… so this is Keel. Indeed, quite the resemblance. Azott, you should get along well with Luna and Keel. My original manufacturing purpose was Azott’s healthy and happy future. For the sake of a happy Christmas.”
Somehow Rafumi was saying something Motoyasu was sure he’d heard before.
“D-don’t screw around! Hurry up and help me!”
“Azott, even across different worlds, I support Azott’s romance. A flower in each hand—you should get along splendidly with both.”
“The moment that pain-in-the-neck Kuro backs off, it’s this one’s turn—give me a break already! Let goooooo!”

And so, still cradled in Luna-chan’s arms, Ren was carried straight off toward the back of the tent, indeed. Speaking of which, this reminded Motoyasu of Ren being awakened by Black Thunder—in the loop where he’d reunited with Fleon-chan, Rafumi and the others hadn’t shown up, had they? Now that he thought about it… Motoyasu had some recollection of Ren attending a party Keel had thrown at Christmas.
“A-anyway, we need to calm Luna-chan down! Motoyasu-kun, come with me!”

Either way, with nowhere else to go and Luna-chan persistently calling out to him, Ren, half-resigned, ended up living in the circus tent, indeed. Ah, and Rafumi, acting as Ren’s body double, had been handling command of Ren’s party together with Kuro-chan.
It was a little while after Ren had been captured by Luna-chan and settled into life as a pet, indeed.
“Glad you won again today. So, how does it feel competing in the Zeltoble Colosseum?”

Crocodile Guy, who’d been taking advice from Panda’s grandfather and Granny, had asked Father if he could test his skills in the Zeltoble Colosseum, and had been competing there these past few days, indeed. So Father and Rabbit Guy were accompanying him at the colosseum, indeed. Motoyasu had asked whether he should join in too, but was told he needn’t bother, so he went and watched the Filolial-sama races with Yuki-chan instead, indeed. As expected, the Filolial races seemed to stir Yuki-chan’s blood, and she’d been positively thrilled. Motoyasu promised Yuki-chan that she’d get to race herself someday, indeed. Afterward, Yuki-chan said she was interested in the stables near the Filolial racetrack and went off, leaving Motoyasu behind. Perhaps there was something to be learned there. He’d go pick her up later, indeed.

“Showing off strength for no reason isn’t to my taste, but in terms of seeing the world, it’s educational… though since my instructors and colleagues are all seasoned fighters, there’s not much I can actually learn.”

The only thing he was picking up, Crocodile Guy answered with a sigh, was his opponents’ dirty fighting tactics. Incidentally, Éclair, who Crocodile Guy was looking after, had been absorbed in training with Granny and the others. Until the Queen returned, she was helping out with Father’s circus, and was apparently taking on the role of performing things like sword dances, at least nominally, indeed. Thanks to Éclair joining, support from the Siltvelt side had apparently improved somewhat, or so the story went. Though raising support too much risked being seen as an opportunity and sparking a war, so keeping it to the bare minimum remained unchanged. Well, since Éclair belonged to a faction focused on building friendly relations, the talk was that support wouldn’t swing toward anything extreme.
“Everyone’s a seasoned fighter, after all~”

The one instructing him was Granny along with Panda’s grandfather, and his fellow trainees were Panda, Elephant, Éclair, plus Wolf and Rabbit Guy, indeed. Older Sister sometimes joined in too. Being a formidable fighter to begin with, she seemed to spar mostly with Panda and Elephant, indeed. According to Panda, she’d been astonished, wondering why someone like this wasn’t already in Zeltoble. Depending on circumstances, they might well have crossed paths before, though. That night, after getting roaringly drunk, Older Sister ended up getting dumped on Father, as always.
“Not to boast, but I think I’m being taught by fighters who’d rank among the top five in the world. That’s about how stacked this lineup is.”
Both Panda and Elephant were renowned fighters in Zeltoble, indeed.
“Whatever else, Lars-chan and the others are apparently famous people. Even though she’s such a cute panda.”
Father shared his thoughts on Panda. Indeed, Father seemed to have taken quite a liking to Panda.
“I think I saw her on the way back just now. She was downing drinks at the tavern like there was no tomorrow.”

“Ahh… seems like having family nearby makes her tense. Grandpa’s training with insane energy and dragging her along, plus there’s helping with the circus too, so she said she’d be entering the arena tomorrow.”
“I think I get how she feels.”
“Vof.”

While watching Crocodile Guy’s matches, Father seemed to be gathering information around Zeltoble—about the circumstances behind how Wolf became a slave, and whether there was any effective treatment for Rabbit Guy’s illness.
“Are you going to enter the colosseum too, Motoyasu-kun?”
“I’ve competed around this time before, indeed. Wearing a mask, becoming famous as the Filolial Mask! If it’s prize money you want earned, I’ll rake in as much as you like.”

How nostalgic. It reminded Motoyasu of entering for Father’s sake back when the loop had restarted. He’d earned money from afar to buy back the people of Big Sister’s village, indeed. That said, given the current situation of him going around Melromarc as a slave trader, apparently quite a lot of Big Sister’s village people had already been gathered.
“Money’s, well… we’re pretty flush from trading, so we’re not too troubled there. It was more like, how about testing your skills? That kind of thing.”
“If Spear Hero enters, there’s no way we could ever win.”
“Kuun…”
Crocodile Guy and the others voiced their opinions on Father’s question. What was that about? Motoyasu could wipe the lot of them out easily, indeed.
“If anything, how about betting all our assets on my first appearance and scoring a huge win? That seems like the safer bet.”
